linkedin.justification: The post captures core themes well, but fails the requirement to include 3-5 relevant hashtags.

flyer.justification: Follows all flyer constraints with a concise title under 6 words, high-impact highlights, and TBA logistics placeholders.

summary.justification: Succinct, well-structured executive briefing meeting all formatting, length, and section criteria.

instagram.justification: The draft misses the required 10-15 targeted hashtags and carousel/visual slide cues entirely.

newsletter.justification: Well written with an engaging editorial tone, three distinct subheaded sections, and a subject line under 50 characters.

blog.justification: Accurately represents the talk in a well-formatted long-form structure complete with numbered sections, takeaway table, and author bio.
